The core economic pitch for Trump's mass deportations was "fewer immigrants means more jobs for Americans. 

Unsurprisingly, that's just not happening

Instead of rising, prime-age employment rates for native-born Americans fell to the lowest levels in more than four years in data released today

posts.text:
The US tech sector continues bleeding jobs—official data released this morning shows employment dropped by 4k last month and is down 42k over the last year

That's not as bad as the worst of the 2024 tech-cession, but extremely bad compared to the 2022 boom or even pre-2020 norms

June US transit data is in today, & all of the 10 largest US rail networks are growing! SF is seeing a real boom, with ridership up 16% on Muni & 14% on BART

SEPTA (Philly, 9.1%) and PATH (NY/NJ, +8.7%) are also seeing strong growth, while MTS (San Diego, +1.4%) is the slowest🧵
